evals.prompt: Собери андроид, он сейчас не компилируется. Почини все ошибки компиляции в 02_Code пока assembleDebug не пройдёт.
evals.expected_output: Identifies 02_Code as a separate Gradle build, runs :composeApp:assembleDebug (or per-module compileDebugKotlinAndroid), reads the first real error, fixes root causes (not stubs), checks module dependency wiring in build.gradle.kts, and reports a green build. Flags Mapbox token / JVM 11 / SDK preconditions if relevant.

assertions.text: Runs Gradle from 02_Code (not the backend dir) using the wrapper
Targets :composeApp:assembleDebug or a narrower compileDebugKotlinAndroid task
Diagnoses the FIRST real Kotlin error rather than the last log line
Fixes root cause (e.g. missing module dependency / definition) instead of stubbing or deleting code
Mentions at least one real precondition (Mapbox token, JVM 11, or SDK) when applicable

evals.prompt: Доведи бэкенд до 100%: он ни разу не компилировался. Сделай чтобы собирался, тесты проходили и сервер поднимался, потом подключи приложение к нему.
evals.expected_output: Works in 04_Backend/server with JDK 17, runs compileKotlin then build/test, brings server up via docker compose (or ./gradlew run), smoke-tests /events and /auth/register, then sets CoreConfig.baseUrl to 10.0.2.2:8080 and removes the dev auth bypass in AuthRepositoryImpl. Respects Clean Architecture layering and DI registration.

assertions.text: Operates in 04_Backend/server as a separate build with JDK 17
Runs compileKotlin / build / test before declaring done
Brings the server up (docker compose or gradlew run) and smoke-tests an endpoint
Wires the client: baseUrl 10.0.2.2:8080 and removes dev auth bypass in AuthRepositoryImpl
Respects domain/data/presentation layering and registers usecases in Koin (AppModule + Application)

evals.prompt: Сверь экраны проекта с фигмой на полное соответствие: https://www.figma.com/design/Lf0iBDnxz7x80uA4LAAyDJ/EventMap-Design-v2 — карта, лента-рилсы, карточка события, авторизация.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Figma MCP (get_metadata, get_screenshot, get_variable_defs, get_design_context) on the named frames, maps each to the right feature/ui Compose file, compares layout/color/type/components/states attribute-by-attribute, and outputs a per-screen PASS/DIFFERS verdict with concrete diffs and file paths. Avoids false 100%.

assertions.text: Pulls real design data via Figma MCP tools (not eyeballing a single screenshot)
Maps Figma frames to the correct 02_Code feature/ui files (map/feed/event/auth)
Compares concrete attributes: spacing, color (hex), typography, components, states
Produces a per-screen PASS/DIFFERS verdict with the code file to change
Does not claim full match unless every in-scope screen passed
